## Testing

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:png` (if rendering, fonts, or Chromium lifecycle changed)
- [ ] `npm run test:package` (if package layout or entry points changed)

## Checklist

- [ ] User-visible changes are listed under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] README or other docs are updated when behavior or configuration changed
